seo.title: AI Use-Case Scenarios | AInspiration
seo.description: Three typical AI automation scenarios for SMEs — plus AInspiration's real case: this site runs on our own tools.

pageTitle: What AI changes, trade by trade
pageSubtitle: Three typical scenarios built from our areas of expertise. The figures are realistic orders of magnitude — your free audit establishes yours.

study1.title: Automating customer service with an AI chatbot
study1.challenge: A growing online shop is buried under repetitive enquiries: order tracking, returns, product questions. Response times stretch and satisfaction drops.
study1.solution: An AI chatbot trained on frequent questions, integrated with the website and social media, with automatic handover to a human as soon as a case falls outside its scope.
study1.result3: The team focuses on complex cases
study1.result4: Support costs kept in check despite growth

study2.title: Automating invoice processing
study2.challenge: Hundreds of invoices processed by hand every month: late payments, data-entry errors, and one to two full-time staff tied up in typing.
study2.solution: AI-powered invoice data extraction, integrated with the existing accounting software, with human validation on ambiguous cases.
study2.result4: Freed-up time goes to analysis, not typing

study3.title: Anticipating stock with predictive analytics
study3.challenge: Frequent stockouts on popular items, while capital sits idle in slow-moving products.
study3.solution: A predictive model fed with sales history, seasonality and trends, recommending replenishments at the right moment.
